text: 金十数据7月11日讯，乘联分会秘书长崔东树发文表示，中国宏观经济保持较强增长，在国家促销费政策推动下汽车市场保持强势增长，2026年全国汽车市场总体走势较平稳，在生产资料高补贴卡车市场和客车市场回暖明显。2026年商用车市场出现设备更新补贴推动的结构性增长特征，刚落地的商用车高补贴带来物流运输类电动化加速，商用车景气度较高。由于去年消费政策力度超强，2026年政策收缩明显，入门级消费支持政策剧烈下降，导致今年1-6月乘用车零售持续负增长，尤其是燃油乘用车出现崩塌式下滑。但因出口增量，6月厂家销量增速相对平稳。6月新能源车走势不强，汽车出口市场持续走强，厂
text_en: July 11 (Jin10 Data) — Cui Dongshu, Secretary-General of the China Passenger Car Association, stated that China's macro economy maintains relatively strong growth. Driven by the national consumption promotion policy, the auto market shows robust growth, with the overall national auto market trend in 2026 remaining relatively stable, and a notable recovery in the truck and bus markets supported by high subsidies for production materials. In 2026, the commercial vehicle market exhibits structural growth driven by equipment update subsidies, with newly implemented high subsidies for commercial vehicles accelerating logistics and transportation electrification, leading to high commercial vehicle prosperity. Due to extremely strong consumption policy support last year, policy tightening is evident in 2026, with a sharp decline in support policies for entry-level consumption, resulting in sustained negative growth in passenger car retail sales from January to June this year, especially a collapse in fuel-powered passenger car sales. However, driven by export growth, manufacturer sales growth in June remained relatively stable. New energy vehicles showed weak performance in June, while auto export markets continued to strengthen.
